title: Included Haul-Away Items by Membership on Northgate Delivery & Installation
content:
On a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment, the included haul-away items — the old appliances removed before any is charged — follow the membership presented on the purchase being delivered, by its tier as Northgate Memberships records it:

| Membership presented on the purchase being delivered | Included haul-away items |
|---|---|
| Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership | None, because removal for a business account is never free |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 2 |
| Any other membership | The service level's included haul-away items |

## Points of judgement

- A Business or Business Plus membership has no included items at any service level.
- A Club Plus membership has 2 included items whatever the service level's own figure.
- Any other membership — for example a Northgate Club Membership — has the service level's own included haul-away items.

**Hypothetical appointment.** Three old appliances are removed. With a Northgate Club Plus Membership presented, 2 are included and 1 is beyond them; with a Northgate Business Membership presented, none is included and all 3 are beyond.
